name: Telegram Bot  Gentle Companion for Garden
description: Evolve Telegram bot into a living Gentle Companion. Core infrastructure complete (v6.0.2). Now moving toward free dialogue, intent detection, mood tracking, voice messages, and SR integration as the central interaction layer.
done: v6.0.2: In-memory store  zero GitHub blocking, <100ms responses
v6.0.2: Fire-and-forget GitHub sync (concurrent, every 2 min)
v6.0.2: Health check endpoint  stable Render deployment
v6.0.1: _load_store before webhook  no message loss on restart
Proactive messages: morning/evening with Ahimsa silence policy
FSM task and achievement flows without hanging
Callback.answer() first  no TelegramBadRequest on restart
deliverables_next: STAGE 1: Fallback handler  any free text goes to SR, returns {text, intent, action}
STAGE 2: Intent detection  task/achievement/search/mood suggestions from natural speech
STAGE 2: Web search integration  connect main.py search to bot via intent
STAGE 3: Mood tracker  analyze message tone, adaptive SR responses
STAGE 4: Voice messages in  Groq Whisper transcription
STAGE 4: Voice messages out  TTS responses (2nd priority)
STAGE 5: Pattern analysis  weekly/monthly recommendations from history
acceptance_criteria: Gardener can freely converse  bot responds naturally via SR
Bot detects intent from natural language and suggests actions
Bot adapts tone based on gardener mood signals
Voice messages transcribed and processed as text
All existing commands stable, no hangs

architecture.dialogue: Any message  SR (main.py)  {text, intent, action}  bot responds + optional action button
architecture.voice: Telegram voice  Groq Whisper  text  SR pipeline
architecture.search: intent=web_search  main.py search tool  formatted result

health.notes: v6.0.2 stable. Health check endpoint stops Render restarts. Moving to live dialogue phase.
